Updated notes.md with corrected findings and a simpler Season 7 rule: **Book Vagabond or Pacific Voyager on every Friday starting D1, hold all half-days, never pre-commit PTO far ahead**. Current strategy.py is obsolete and needs rewriting to this simpler, boat-focused approach.

**Summary:** Corrected Season 7 strategy from flawed Phase 1/2/3 (based on wrong D85 "peak" analysis) to boat-first early-season execution (Vagabond Fridays D1-D56), because data shows boat choice overwhelms timing (9x performance spread) and early season is actually hotter than mid-season.
